title: South Africa Deported 57,000+ People in 2025, New Statistics Show
detail: Newly released immigration enforcement statistics reveal that more than 57,000 people were deported from South Africa in 2025, highlighting the scale of the country's immigration enforcement operations amid ongoing debates about border management and irregular migration.

media.caption: Over 57,000 people deported from South Africa in 2025 according to new immigration statistics
